name: Shrimp "Summer Roll" Bowl with Rice Noodles, Veggies & Peanut Sauce

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 small pkg fresh mint
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, add shrimp to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to a plate. (Reserve boiling water in pot for the next step.)

Add rice noodles to the pot with the boiling water, remove from heat, and soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a clean colander, rinse under cold water, and set aside.
Meanwhile, cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place on a large plate.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the plate with the green onions.
Trim and cut cucumbers into thin matchsticks. Add to the plate.
Trim, seed, and cut bell peppers into thin matchsticks. Add to the plate.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the plate.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the plate and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl along with peanut butter, honey, soy sauce, fish sauce, and vinegar. Whisk to combine the peanut sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
½ cup natural peanut butter
3 tbsp honey
1 tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice noodles, veggies, and shrimp between bowls. Drizzle with peanut sauce and enjoy!
